A LITTLE CLOSER LOOK

Make your next study session count.

A difficult question is useful information. Revisen helps you keep it, connect it to your course and return to the part you need to practise.

01

Keep the question

Capture a problem from text, a screenshot or your camera. Add your working and the answer key when available, then organise it by course and topic.

02

Connect it to your course

Add PDF or text materials and inspect suggested source passages. Confirm the links yourself so each saved question points back to the material that helps explain it.

03

Practise the next step

Use calculation-checked numerical practice for supported equations, differentiation, integration and motion questions. Other problems use self-marked original-question practice. Revisit work when it is due.

EARLY ACCESS / ANDROID

Try Revisen.
See what clicks.

Connect, then get curious.

Get a reachable Revisen server URL from your test organiser and enter it in Connection settings. You can then create an account or explore the server’s sample workspace.

This is a server-dependent pilot. Without a reachable backend, the learning workspace will not work. Optional AI transcription and explanations need a configured Gemini service; they do not establish mastery or grade all question types.

BACKEND SETUP REQUIRED

Revisen 0.1.0

163.8 MB · Android 7.0+
Published 17 September 2026

A reachable Revisen backend is required for accounts, course materials and practice. No public backend is supplied by this download. Ask the person running your test for their server URL and enter it in the app’s Connection settings. Installing the APK alone is not enough to use the learning workspace.
